verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documented data-retention policies, retention periods, or privacy-oriented deletion controls for Dagster or Dagster+. The only related item is a changelog note about wiping and deleting dynamic partitions (dagster-docs-25). That is an adjacent pipeline-management operation on asset partitions, not a privacy-posture retention or deletion control, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
